# Rerun CellChat from Seurat object

Get NS (no stim) cells

```{r get NS cells}
# read in the merged Seurat object
merged_tumors <- readRDS(file = "final_merged_all.rds")

# get only NS (non-stimulated) sample
Idents(merged_tumors) <- "condition"
NS_subset <- subset(merged_tumors,ident="NS")
# expect only NS
table(NS_subset@meta.data$condition)

# get only SLR14 sample
Idents(merged_tumors) <- "condition"
SLR14_subset <- subset(merged_tumors,ident="SLR14")
# expect only SLR14
table(SLR14_subset@meta.data$condition)

# get only IFNb sample
Idents(merged_tumors) <- "condition"
IFNb_subset <- subset(merged_tumors,ident="IFNb")
# expect only IFNb
table(IFNb_subset@meta.data$condition)

#table(merged_tumors$condition)

rm(merged_tumors)
```

Make sure the MCC samples have only MCC (no MEL) and vice versa
- Method 1: change those mislabeled MCC to MEL and vice versa
- Method 2: directly delete those mislabeled cells

```{r correct tumor cell types}
condition_subset <- IFNb_subset ##REMEMBER to change correct subset

# identify cells with incorrect label
MCC_mislabel <- which(condition_subset@meta.data$type == "MCC" 
                      & condition_subset@meta.data$broad_cell_type == "melanoma tumor cells")

MEL_mislabel <- which(condition_subset@meta.data$type == "MEL" & 
                        (condition_subset@meta.data$broad_cell_type == "Merkel Cell Carcinoma tumor cells" |
                           condition_subset@meta.data$broad_cell_type == "proliferating MCC tumor cells" |
                           condition_subset@meta.data$broad_cell_type == "MCC tumor cells"))

# Method 1: update the cell_type
#condition_subset@meta.data$broad_cell_type[MCC_mislabel] <- "MCC tumor cells"
#condition_subset@meta.data$broad_cell_type[MEL_mislabel] <- "melanoma tumor cells"

# Method 2: delete those cells
cells_to_remove <- colnames(condition_subset)[c(MCC_mislabel, MEL_mislabel)]
condition_subset <- subset(condition_subset, cells = cells_to_remove, invert = TRUE)
```


Want MCC NS, MEL NS, R NS, NR NS

```{r subset into MCC MEL R NR}
# MCC
Idents(condition_subset) <- "type"
MCC_subset <- subset(condition_subset, ident="MCC")
# expect only MCC
table(MCC_subset@meta.data$type)

# MEL
Idents(condition_subset) <- "type"
MEL_subset <- subset(condition_subset, ident="MEL")
# expect only MEL
table(MEL_subset@meta.data$type)

# R
Idents(condition_subset) <- "Response"
R_subset <- subset(condition_subset, ident="R")
# expect only R
table(R_subset@meta.data$Response)

# NR
Idents(condition_subset) <- "Response"
NR_subset <- subset(condition_subset, ident="NR")
# expect only NR
table(NR_subset@meta.data$Response)
```

 Merge cell types to broader cell types

```{r merge cell type for MCC}
# update cell type
MCC_subset@meta.data <- mutate(MCC_subset@meta.data, cell_type_CC = case_when(
  broad_cell_type == "memory CD4+ T cell- low ISG" ~ "CD4 T cells",
  broad_cell_type == "memory CD4+ T cell- high ISG" ~ "CD4 T cells",
  broad_cell_type == "CD4+ T cells (Tfh?)" ~ "CD4 T cells",
  broad_cell_type == "CD8+ T cell-effector memory" ~ "CD8 T cells",
  broad_cell_type == "Merkel Cell Carcinoma tumor cells" ~ "MCC",
  broad_cell_type == "proliferating MCC tumor cells" ~ "MCC",
  broad_cell_type == "MCC tumor cells" ~ "MCC",
  broad_cell_type == "melanoma tumor cells" ~ "MCC",
  broad_cell_type == "monocytes (inflammatory M1)" ~ "Myeloid cells",
  broad_cell_type == "DCs" ~ "Myeloid cells",
  broad_cell_type == "macrophages (M2)" ~ "Myeloid cells",
  TRUE ~ broad_cell_type
))

table(MCC_subset@meta.data$broad_cell_type)
table(MCC_subset@meta.data$cell_type_CC)

```

separate each MCC samples
```{r}
Idents(MCC_subset) <- "sample"
table(MCC_subset$sample)
MC79 <- subset(MCC_subset, ident = "MC79") # no interaction (no stim): too few cells
YUEYE <- subset(MCC_subset, ident = "YUEYE")
YUMISTY <- subset(MCC_subset, ident = "YUMISTY")

separate each MEL samples

```


## create CellChat object
```{r create cellchat object from seurat object}
# change to the subset that you want to run
# specifically: MCC_subset, MEL_subset, R_subset, NR_subset, MCC_R_subset, MCC_NR_subset, MC79, YUEYE, YUMISTY, YURAD
seurat_subset <- YUTOUL
table(YUTOUL$cell_type_CC)

# labeles - should be the cell type
Idents(seurat_subset) <- "cell_type_CC"
cellchat <- createCellChat(object = seurat_subset, group.by = "ident", assay = "RNA")
```

Update the cell-type order - R vs. NR
```{r}
# for R vs. NR
R_vs_NR_levels = c("MCC", "MEL", "CD8 T cells", "CD4 T cells", "Tregs", "Myeloid cells", "NK cells", "B cells")

cellchat@meta$cell_type_CC = factor(cellchat@meta$cell_type_CC, levels = R_vs_NR_levels)
cellchat <- setIdent(cellchat, ident.use = "cell_type_CC")

# check if the levels are updated correctly (should return TRUE)
levels(cellchat@idents) == R_vs_NR_levels
```

Update the cell-type order - MCC R vs. MCC NR (also MCC)
```{r}
# for MCC R vs. MCC NR
MCC_R_vs_NR_levels = c("MCC", "CD8 T cells", "CD4 T cells", "Tregs", "Myeloid cells", "NK cells", "B cells")

cellchat@meta$cell_type_CC = factor(cellchat@meta$cell_type_CC, levels = MCC_R_vs_NR_levels)
cellchat <- setIdent(cellchat, ident.use = "cell_type_CC")

# check if the levels are updated correctly (should return TRUE)
levels(cellchat@idents) == MCC_R_vs_NR_levels

#levels(cellchat@idents) = droplevels(cellchat@meta$cell_type_CC, exclude = setdiff(levels(cellchat@idents),unique(cellchat@meta$cell_type_CC)))

```

Update the cell-type order - MCC vs. MEL 
```{r}
# for MEL
MEL_levels = c("MEL", "CD8 T cells", "CD4 T cells", "Tregs", "Myeloid cells", "NK cells", "B cells")

cellchat@meta$cell_type_CC = factor(cellchat@meta$cell_type_CC, levels = MEL_levels)
cellchat <- setIdent(cellchat, ident.use = "cell_type_CC")

# check if the levels are updated correctly (should return TRUE)
levels(cellchat@idents) == MEL_levels
```

## update cellchat database

Use only MDK (or MDK + PTN) L-R interactions
```{r}
# read in the manually defined ligands
MDK_L_R <- read.csv("MDK_PTN_pathway_ligands.csv")

# remove NCL
MDK_L_R <- MDK_L_R[MDK_L_R$receptor != "NCL", ]

# create new DB for MDK L-R pairs
db.MDK <- updateCellChatDB(db = MDK_L_R, gene_info = NULL, species_target = "human")

# update the db used for later CellChat analyses
cellchat@DB <- db.MDK
```


## run cellchat

Preprocessing the expression data for cell-cell communication analysis

```{r}
# subset the expression data of signaling genes for saving computation cost
cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat) # This step is necessary even if using the whole database
#future::plan("multisession", workers = 4) # do parallel
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
```

Compute the communication probability and infer cellular communication network

```{r}
cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = "triMean")
```

Returns a data frame consisting of all the inferred cell-cell communications at the level of ligands/receptors. Set slot.name = "netP" to access the inferred communications at the level of signaling pathways

```{r}
df.net <- subsetCommunication(cellchat, thresh = 0.05)
df.net
```


Calculate the aggregated cell-cell communication network
CellChat calculates the aggregated cell-cell communication network by counting the number of links or summarizing the communication probability.
```{r}
cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)
```

CellChat can also visualize the aggregated cell-cell communication network. For example, showing the number of interactions or the total interaction strength (weights) between any two cell groups using circle plot.
```{r}
groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents))
par(mfrow = c(1,2), xpd=TRUE)
netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$count, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = T, label.edge= F, title.name = "Number of interactions")
netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$weight, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = T, label.edge= F, title.name = "Interaction weights/strength")
```


## save CellChat object

```{r}
saveRDS(cellchat, file = "MEL1_IFNb_cellchat_human.rds")
```
